name: Social Insurance Number (SIN)
description: Apply for the number needed to work in Canada and access certain government programs.
good_to_know: Use the official Service Canada application. Keep your SIN private.

name: Phone plan and SIM card
description: Compare mobile plans and get a SIM card or phone number at a Fredericton store.
hours: Mon–Sat 10 a.m.–8 p.m.; Sun noon–5 p.m.
good_to_know: Compare prepaid and monthly plans, ID requirements and coverage before paying.

name: Open a bank account
description: Learn what identification a bank can accept and how to compare accounts before visiting a branch.
address: Online; bank branch of your choice
hours: Branch hours vary; call to confirm
good_to_know: Ask the bank about a basic chequing account; a SIN is not the identification requirement for every account.

name: Home internet setup
description: Check internet availability at your exact Fredericton address and arrange installation.
good_to_know: Ask your landlord whether internet is included; compare available providers and contract terms.

name: MCAF newcomer registration
description: Register with the Multicultural Association of Fredericton to access settlement guidance and programs.
good_to_know: Ask the intake team which services fit your immigration status.

name: Start NB Power service
description: Set up electricity for your home when the bill will be in your name.
hours: Online request; call to confirm activation
good_to_know: Have the full address and move-in date ready; ask the landlord first if power is included.

name: Fredericton water and sewer
description: Find city water and sewer information and how utility bills are handled.
good_to_know: Ask your landlord whether utilities are included in rent.

name: Service Fredericton
description: City service desk for municipal questions, transit passes and water or sewer billing.
good_to_know: Call 506-460-2020 for city service questions.

name: MCAF settlement support
description: Get local orientation about housing, banking, schools and government services.
good_to_know: Services may depend on eligibility; begin with intake.

name: City newcomer guide
description: Use the City of Fredericton’s guide to basic services and neighbourhood information.
good_to_know: Start here when you do not know which local office handles a task.

name: Fredericton Boyce Farmers Market
description: Saturday market for produce, prepared food and local goods.
good_to_know: Check the current market calendar before going.

name: Giant Tiger — Smythe Street
description: Budget clothing, home items and pantry groceries on the south side.
good_to_know: Check the store flyer for current prices.

name: Lawtons Brookside Mall
description: North-side pharmacy and shop for prescriptions and everyday personal-care items.
hours: Store: Mon–Sat 9 a.m.–9 p.m.; Sun noon–5 p.m.; confirm pharmacy hours
good_to_know: Call the pharmacy to confirm services and appointment needs.

name: Isaac’s Way restaurant
description: Downtown restaurant with a menu online when you want a place to eat.
hours: Mon–Fri 11:30 a.m.–9 p.m.; Sat–Sun 10 a.m.–9 p.m.
good_to_know: Check menu and reservations before going.

name: Dollarama — Main Street
description: Low-cost household basics, school supplies and small pantry items.
hours: Mon–Sat 8 a.m.–9 p.m.; Sun 9 a.m.–5 p.m.
good_to_know: Check the shelf price and package size.

name: Greener Village food bank
description: Food support for eligible people in the Fredericton area.
good_to_know: Check registration and visit rules before going.

name: Unique Boutique thrift store
description: Second-hand clothing and household goods at Greener Village.
hours: Mon–Fri 9 a.m.–5 p.m.; Sat 9 a.m.–4 p.m.
good_to_know: A practical stop for affordable home essentials.

name: Fredericton Public Library
description: Public library with books, community space and access to library services.
good_to_know: Ask staff how to get a library card.

name: Oskar Barbershop
description: Downtown barbershop for a haircut or beard trim with online booking.
good_to_know: Book or call ahead to confirm availability.

name: Fredericton recycling
description: Find the current recycling calendar and what belongs in each collection stream.
good_to_know: Check your address; 2026 collection arrangements have changed.

name: Uride Fredericton
description: App-based ride service in Fredericton for requesting a car, similar to Uber.
good_to_know: Download the app before you need a ride; check actual driver availability.

name: Fredericton Transit schedules
description: Find bus routes and weekday, Saturday and Sunday schedules before travelling.
hours: Schedules vary by route and day
good_to_know: Check the last bus before making evening plans or a grocery trip.

name: MyRide live bus arrivals
description: See estimated bus arrivals and service changes for your stop on your phone.
good_to_know: Use the four-digit stop number or select a route.

name: Fredericton Transit fares
description: Check current bus fares, passes and contactless debit or credit payment.
good_to_know: A UNB or STU student may already have a U-Pass; check your student account.

name: Route 300 Campus Connect
description: Bus connection serving student destinations and neighbourhoods around Fredericton.
good_to_know: This route started in June 2026; confirm the current map.

name: On-demand transit
description: Request transit service on the city’s on-demand routes instead of waiting for a fixed timetable.
address: Eligible bus stops on routes 18 and 20
good_to_know: Check whether your trip is inside the service area.

name: Fredericton airport ground transport
description: Find taxi, rideshare and rental car information for travel between the airport and town.
good_to_know: Arrange arrival transport in advance, especially late at night.

name: Fredericton paid parking
description: Learn where and when to pay for city street and lot parking.
good_to_know: East End Garage has different payment hours from other city parking.

name: MCAF newcomer groups
description: Meet other newcomers through conversation, arts, sport and social groups.
good_to_know: Ask about group eligibility and current dates.

name: First Fredericton Friends
description: Volunteer match that introduces newcomers to people, places and activities.
good_to_know: Start with MCAF intake to ask if the program fits you.

name: Volunteer with MCAF
description: Meet people while helping with newcomer events or conversation practice.
good_to_know: Contact the volunteer coordinator about openings.

name: MCAF language classes
description: Join eligible English classes or ask for support finding French learning options.
good_to_know: Registration and eligibility are handled through MCAF intake.

name: Fredericton events calendar
description: Find local festivals, performances and community activities by date.
good_to_know: Check each event page before leaving home.

name: Fredericton recreation programs
description: Search classes, workshops, sports and seasonal activities run by the city.
good_to_know: Some registrations require a city Rec Card.

name: Fredericton Playhouse
description: Find live music, theatre, comedy and other performances downtown.
hours: By event; box office hours vary
good_to_know: Check the event listing for tickets and accessibility.

name: Beaverbrook Art Gallery
description: Visit art exhibitions and programs near the downtown riverfront.
hours: Mon–Wed, Fri–Sun 10 a.m.–5 p.m.; Thu 10 a.m.–9 p.m.
good_to_know: Check admission and special holiday hours.

name: NB Medicare eligibility
description: Check whether your immigration or residency situation qualifies for provincial health coverage.
good_to_know: Eligible full-time international students can apply; exchange and part-time students are excluded under this policy.

name: Apply for NB Medicare
description: Read the application and required documents, including the rules for eligible international students.
good_to_know: Coverage is assessed individually; do not assume it begins before confirmation.

name: UNB international health insurance
description: Check guard.me enrolment, Medicare opt-out rules and university insurance deadlines.
good_to_know: A valid NB Medicare card or confirmation may allow an opt-out by the deadline.

name: NB Health Link
description: Join the provincial list for a primary care provider and access interim care while waiting.
good_to_know: Register online or call 1-833-354-2300.

name: Tele-Care 811
description: Call a nurse for help finding an appropriate non-emergency care service.
good_to_know: For an emergency, call 911.

name: Fredericton Downtown Community Health Centre
description: Book a limited same-day nurse practitioner appointment; in-person walk-ins are not accepted.
hours: Mon–Fri; call to confirm appointment times
good_to_know: Call 506-452-5689 or use the booking link on Horizon’s page.

name: Fredericton Urgent Treatment Centre
description: Horizon facility for urgent, non-emergency care; registration is in person.
good_to_know: Patients are assessed by triage; check the official page before visiting.

name: NB pharmacy services
description: Learn which publicly funded services local pharmacists may offer and how to access them.
good_to_know: Coverage and eligibility vary; call ahead for an appointment.

name: Fredericton restaurants directory
description: Browse restaurants and cafés around Fredericton by cuisine and area.
hours: Check linked page for current hours
good_to_know: Use the directory to find more choices; confirm opening hours and menu with the restaurant.

name: Caribbean Flavas
description: Caribbean restaurant with dine-in meals in downtown Fredericton.
hours: Check linked page for current hours
good_to_know: Check the current menu and hours before visiting.

name: Namaste Bistro
description: Indian restaurant with curries and dine-in or takeout options.
hours: Check linked page for current hours
good_to_know: Check the current menu and hours before visiting.

name: Naru Japanese Cuisine
description: Downtown Japanese restaurant serving sushi for dine-in or takeout.
hours: Check linked page for current hours
good_to_know: Check the current menu and hours before visiting.

name: Byblos Restaurant & Bar
description: Downtown Lebanese restaurant serving shared plates and entrées.
hours: Check linked page for current hours
good_to_know: Check the current menu and hours before visiting.

name: Dr. Everett Chalmers Regional Hospital
description: Find Fredericton’s regional hospital and emergency department.
hours: Check linked page for current hours
good_to_know: For a life-threatening emergency, call 911. Ask about charges if you do not yet have valid coverage.

name: Oromocto Public Hospital
description: Find the nearby Oromocto hospital and its emergency department.
hours: Check linked page for current hours
good_to_know: Check the current service status before travelling. For a life-threatening emergency, call 911.

name: Find a medical clinic
description: Find non-emergency medical clinics and current clinic listings in New Brunswick.
hours: Check linked page for current hours
good_to_know: Many clinics need a same-day booking before you arrive. Ask about fees and accepted insurance.

name: Fredericton Public Health Clinic
description: Find the Fredericton Public Health location and contact details for public health services.
hours: Check linked page for current hours
good_to_know: Call 506-453-5200 to confirm which service is offered and whether an appointment is needed.

name: Virtual Care NB
description: Learn about virtual appointments for common non-emergency health problems.
hours: Check linked page for current hours
good_to_know: A valid New Brunswick Medicare card is required for this provincial service.

name: Check what NB Medicare covers
description: Read the provincial list of insured and uninsured services, including hospital care, medicines and dental care.
hours: Check linked page for current hours
good_to_know: Medicare does not cover every service. Confirm a specific bill with the provider or the province.

name: New Brunswick Drug Plan
description: Learn how eligible New Brunswick residents without prescription drug insurance can enrol in a drug plan.
hours: Check linked page for current hours
good_to_know: Check eligibility, premiums and co-payments before enrolling; this is separate from Medicare.

name: Check prescription drug coverage
description: Search the New Brunswick Drug Plans formulary to see which medicines may be covered.
hours: Check linked page for current hours
good_to_know: Being listed does not guarantee your own plan will pay. Confirm your plan and any special authorization.

name: UNB international student insurance details
description: Check UNB’s guard.me emergency plan, enrollment, opt-out rules and policy details.
hours: Check linked page for current hours
good_to_know: Check your own policy for covered services, exclusions and dates before treatment.

name: Canadian Dental Care Plan
description: Check eligibility for federal dental coverage and find how to apply.
hours: Check linked page for current hours
good_to_know: Eligibility depends on several criteria, including access to other dental coverage.
